method: Directed exact-title, exact-first-sentence, named-entity and distinctive-fragment public-web search; reviewed results were compared for verbal identity and case identity.

queries.query: "Different approaches to urban farming" "Green Roof Collective" "Lina Torres"

resultsReviewed.title: Urban Agriculture — USDA National Agricultural Library
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical institutional overview of rooftop, school, community and controlled-environment agriculture; no named-entity or verbatim passage match.

resultsReviewed.title: Urban Agriculture — US EPA
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical public-sector source on vacant land; no exact project, person or passage match.

queries.query: "Different approaches to studying memory" "Helen Ward" "Moreno Lab" "Kenji Sato"

resultsReviewed.title: Active decision-making and route learning — PubMed
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Conceptually related primary research; no match for Helen Ward, the stated pause/prediction protocol or the passage wording.

resultsReviewed.title: The effect of relative confidence and the co-witness memory conformity effect — DOI 10.1002/acp.3320
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Conceptually close to confident social misinformation and therefore a provenance alert, but no nominal or verbatim match to Moreno Lab.

queries.query: "City transport policies with different goals" "Rivergate Bus Priority Plan" "Northbridge Safe Streets Programme"

resultsReviewed.title: Bus Priority Programme — Transport for London
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical institutional source on bus priority and kerbside activity; no Rivergate identity or verbatim match.

resultsReviewed.title: Mobility as a Service code of practice — UK Department for Transport
resultsReviewed.reasonNotExactMatch: Topical public-sector source on multimodal integration and digital exclusion; no named programme or passage match.

interpretation: Directed and non-exhaustive. No exact match in reviewed results does not prove originality, authorship, clearance or universal absence of a prior source. The search did not cover licensed databases, print-only works, deleted pages, translations, private documents, drafts or extensive paraphrase. Repository history establishes when content entered this repository, not who created it; conceptual similarity in the memory passage requires human source reconstruction, not automatic attribution.
